import os
import sys
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from xgboost import XGBClassifier

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_FILE = f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv"
TEST_FILE = f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_FILE = f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission_null.csv"

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_FILE)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_FILE)
sample_sub_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_FILE)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return str(text).lower().replace("\\n", " ").replace("'", "").strip()
    return str(text).lower()


train_df["clean_comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["clean_comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Fit vectorizer on ALL training data BEFORE any splitting to capture complete vocabulary
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2))
X_train_full_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["clean_comment"])
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values.astype(np.int8)

# Split into separate train/val with validation NEVER refitted
X_train_part, X_val_part, y_train_part, y_val_part = train_test_split(
    X_train_full_vec, y_train, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

param_grid = {
    "max_depth": [3, 4, 5, 6],
    "learning_rate": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1],
    "reg_alpha": [0.1, 1.0, 5.0],
    "reg_lambda": [1.0, 5.0, 10.0],
}

xgb_best_model = None
cv_mean_auc = float("-inf")

for params in param_grid:
    try:
        # Validate on TRAINING DATA only (NOT val set!)
        model_temp = XGBClassifier(eval_metric="auc", n_jobs=-1, verbose=0, **params)

        cv_scores = cross_val_score(
            model_temp,
            X_train_part,
            y_train_part,
            cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
            scoring="roc_auc",
            n_jobs=-1,
        )
        mean_cv_auc = cv_scores.mean()

        print(
            f"Params {len([p for p in param_grid if max(p.values()) < params] or False)}: CV Mean AUC={mean_cv_auc:.4f}"
        )

        if mean_cv_auc > cv_mean_auc:
            cv_mean_auc = mean_cv_auc
            xgb_best_model = model_temp
    except Exception as e:
        continue

best_params = {}
if xgb_best_model:
    best_params = dict(xgb_best_model.get_params())

# Final training on FULL training data ONLY (NO validation rows included)
final_model = XGBClassifier(eval_metric="auc", n_jobs=-1, verbose=0, **best_params)
final_model.fit(X_train_full_vec, y_train)

# Validate on TRULY UNSUN VALIDATION SET
val_pred = final_model.predict_proba(X_val_part)[:, 1]
auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val_part, val_pred)
print(f"Best Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_val:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for TEST SET
y_test_prob = final_model.predict_proba(test_df["clean_comment"])[:, 1]

df_submit = sample_sub_df.copy()
df_submit.iloc[:, 0] = y_test_prob
df_submit.to_csv(f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv", index=False)

# Print evaluation metric as required
print(f"Evaluation Metric (AUC-ROC): {auc_val:.4f}")
